policies.sentence: Industry expects AI fluency, so future software engineers need to learn to use AI tools effectively and responsibly.
Employers assess job candidates without AI, and interviews do not allow AI, so unaided skills matter.
Over-reliance on AI means missing insights from doing the work and leaves students less prepared for industry.
Much of the software industry prohibits AI use because of serious concerns.
Students should consider carefully how showing AI-produced work affects how employers see them.
